text:
perf-bot: [ALERT] nightly-ci/perf: small-batch throughput regression detected (-18%) on model rwdn-turbo-7b (seq=512, batch=2) on runner ci-gpu-09. dashboard: https://internal.perf/alerts/2212345678 :rotating_light:

maria: seeing the perf alert first thing. @ash @devon can you take a quick look? this hit the canary nightly job at ~03:00 UTC.

ash: on it. pulling logs now. any quick repro steps?

devon: fyi i merged scheduler PR #3421 last night (small change to dispatch window). could be related. if you need me i can pause rollouts.

maria: ok noted @devon. @ash, try reproducing locally with the nightly benchmark command:

ash: running that now. command i use:

```
./scripts/run_bench.sh --model rwdn-turbo-7b --batch 2 --seq 512 --iters 100 --runner ci-gpu-09
```

ash: quick paste of the tail of the failing run (99th latency):

```
[2026-03-17 03:02:11] model init ok
[2026-03-17 03:07:34] tokens/sec: 1200 (baseline 1460)
[2026-03-17 03:07:35] p99 latency: 188ms (baseline 150ms)
```

yun: timeline note: nightly infra also upgraded CUDA drivers on ci-gpu-09 at 01:00, but metric jump looks coincident with the PR window. both are suspects.

ash: trying two things in parallel: (1) bisect the scheduler change, (2) run perf record to get stacks.

ash: perf record command i'm using:

```
perf record -F 99 -a -g -- ./scripts/run_bench.sh --model rwdn-turbo-7b --batch 2 --seq 512 --iters 50
perf script | stackcollapse-perf.pl > out.folded
flamegraph.pl out.folded > flame.svg
```

devon: if bisect points to #3421 i can open a revert PR real quick. also adding a short-lived feature flag rollback in case this blocks e2e.

maria: thanks. prioritize reproduction within the next 30m. if we confirm regression, we'll hold canary and notify infra to roll back driver if needed.

ash: reproduced locally on ci-gpu-09 image. perf flame shows increased time in scheduler::dispatch_loop and GPU memcpy stalls. attaching snippet:

```
# collapsed stacks sample
scheduler::dispatch_loop;runtime::submit;cudaMemcpy;__memcpy_sse2_unaligned
```

devon: memcpy/vmemstall could also be driver-related. @yun can you check driver upgrade changelog?

yun: checking now. driver 525.85 -> 526.10 at 01:05. release notes mention async memcpy improvements + heuristics. i'll run a quick control job on a pre-upgrade runner.

maria: plan for next steps:
- ash: finish bisect between commit range (HEAD~30..HEAD) and post which commit regressed.
- devon: stand by to revert #3421 or gate it with a feature flag if bisect implicates scheduler.
- yun: validate driver impact by running identical bench on pre-upgrade runner.
- I'll draft a short incident note for #eng-runtime and keep stakeholders in loop.

ash: starting bisect now: `git bisect start HEAD origin/nightly-base -- ./scripts/run_bench.sh --model rwdn-turbo-7b --batch 2 --seq 512 --iters 30` will post results.

perf-bot: [INFO] alert acknowledged by maria. ticket created: PERF-1152.

devon: if we need a quick mitigation, adding a 5ms inter-batch backoff in scheduler might cut contention; can ship as hotfix if needed.

maria: good idea. only ship if bisect + flame confirm. otherwise we risk masking root cause.

ash: bisect iteration 7/15 shows bad at commit fc9a2d (matches parts of #3421). narrowing now.

yun: control job on pre-upgrade runner (ci-gpu-03) shows baseline throughput ~1465 tokens/sec, p99 148ms. so driver likely contributes but not sole cause.

devon: ok i'm prepping a revert PR for the scheduler delta that touches dispatch window. will post link once created.

maria: assign ownership: ash -> lead triage, devon -> potential revert PR, yun -> infra verification. i'll coordinate comms. update here with the revert PR link or flame.svg. :thumbsup:

ash: copying output to /tmp/flame-2212345678.svg and uploading to the perf ticket. will post link when done.

devon: PR created: https://internal/git/PR/3678 reverting scheduler patch (temporary). marking as hotfix.

maria: excellent. i'm going to hold canary and pause the nightly rollout until we validate. thanks team, i'll follow up in PERF-1152 with timeline.

ash: final note, small perf hack to reproduce quickly: set --iters 10 and --warmup 3 to speed cycles. saves time during bisect.

perf-bot: [RESOLUTION] canary paused; alert suppressed while triage active.
